The crew includes NASA astronauts @Astro_Reid, @AstroVicGlover, and @Astro_Christina, and @CanadianSpaceAgency astronaut @AstroJeremy.A combined NASA and U.S. military recovery team will soon extract the astronauts from the Orion spacecraft and fly them to the USS Murtha.
